verses.translation: the pure notion of space, inclined toward the seed and taste of sound; then, gone to density, the mind in the order of dense vibration

verses.sanskrit: भावयत्यनिलस्पन्दं स्पर्शबीजरसोन्मुखम् । ताभ्यामाकाशवाताभ्यां दृढाभ्यासवशात्ततः
verses.transliteration: bhāvayatyanilaspandaṃ sparśabījarasonmukham | tābhyāmākāśavātābhyāṃ dṛḍhābhyāsavaśāttataḥ
verses.translation: contemplates the vibration of air, inclined to the seed and taste of touch; from these two, space and wind, by firm practice,

verses.sanskrit: शब्दस्पर्शस्वरूपाभ्यां संघर्षाज्जन्यतेऽनलः । रूपतन्मात्रसहितं त्रिभिस्तैः सह संमितम्
verses.transliteration: śabdasparśasvarūpābhyāṃ saṃgharṣājjanyate'nalaḥ | rūpatanmātrasahitaṃ tribhistaiḥ saha saṃmitam
verses.translation: from the friction of the natures of sound and touch fire is born, together with the subtle element of form, measured with those three.

verses.sanskrit: मनस्ताद्दृग्गुणगतं रसतन्मात्रवेदनम् । क्षणाच्चेतत्यपां शैत्यं जलसंवित्ततो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: manastāddṛgguṇagataṃ rasatanmātravedanam | kṣaṇāccetatyapāṃ śaityaṃ jalasaṃvittato bhavet
verses.translation: The mind, gone to such qualities, perceives the subtle element of taste; in a moment it perceives the coolness of waters, from which arises the awareness of water.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तादृग्गुणगतं मनो भावयति क्षणात् । गन्धतन्मात्रमेतस्माद्भूमिसंवित्ततो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tatastādṛgguṇagataṃ mano bhāvayati kṣaṇāt | gandhatanmātrametasmādbhūmisaṃvittato bhavet
verses.translation: Then the mind gone to such qualities contemplates in a moment the subtle element of smell; from this arises the awareness of earth.

verses.sanskrit: अथेत्थंभूततन्मात्रवेष्टितं तनुतां जहत् । वपुर्वह्निकणाकारं स्फुरितं व्योम्नि पश्यति
verses.transliteration: athetthaṃbhūtatanmātraveṣṭitaṃ tanutāṃ jahat | vapurvahnikaṇākāraṃ sphuritaṃ vyomni paśyati
verses.translation: Then, enveloped by such subtle elements, giving up thinness, it sees in space a body like a spark of fire, shining.

verses.sanskrit: अहंकारकलायुक्तं बुद्धिबीजसमन्वितम् । तत्पुर्यष्टकमित्युक्तं भूतहृत्पद्मषट्पदम्
verses.transliteration: ahaṃkārakalāyuktaṃ buddhibījasamanvitam | tatpuryaṣṭakamityuktaṃ bhūtahṛtpadmaṣaṭpadam
verses.translation: Joined with a part of egoism, endowed with the seed of intellect, it is called the city of eight, the bee in the lotus of the heart of beings.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तु तीव्रसंवेगाद्भावयद्भासुरं वपुः । स्थूलतामेति पाकेन मनो बिल्वफलं यथा
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃstu tīvrasaṃvegādbhāvayadbhāsuraṃ vapuḥ | sthūlatāmeti pākena mano bilvaphalaṃ yathā
verses.translation: In it, by intense emotion, the mind contemplates a radiant body and becomes gross by ripening, like a bilva fruit.

verses.sanskrit: मूषास्थद्रुतहेमाभं स्फुरितं विमलाम्बरे । संनिवेशमथादत्ते तत्तेजः स्वस्वभावतः
verses.transliteration: mūṣāsthadrutahemābhaṃ sphuritaṃ vimalāmbare | saṃniveśamathādatte tattejaḥ svasvabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: Shining in the clear sky like melted gold in a crucible, that radiance then takes on a form by its own nature.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वं शिरःपिण्डमयमधः पादमयं तथा । पार्श्वयोर्हस्तसंस्थानं मध्ये चोदरधर्मिणम्
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvaṃ śiraḥpiṇḍamayamadhaḥ pādamayaṃ tathā | pārśvayorhastasaṃsthānaṃ madhye codaradharmiṇam
verses.translation: Above, made of a mass of head; below, made of feet; at the sides arranged with hands; in the middle bearing a belly,

verses.sanskrit: कालेन स्फुटतामेत्य भवत्यमलविग्रहम् । बुद्धिसत्त्वबलोत्साहविज्ञानैश्वर्यसंस्थितः
verses.transliteration: kālena sphuṭatāmetya bhavatyamalavigraham | buddhisattvabalotsāhavijñānaiśvaryasaṃsthitaḥ
verses.translation: in time becoming distinct, it takes a stainless body, established in intellect, sattva, strength, energy, knowledge and lordship.

verses.sanskrit: स एव भगवान्ब्रह्मा सर्वलोकपितामहः । अवलोक्य वपुर्ब्रह्मा कान्तमात्मीयमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sa eva bhagavānbrahmā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ | avalokya vapurbrahmā kāntamātmīyamuttamam
verses.translation: He himself is the Lord Brahma, grandfather of all worlds; Brahma, beholding his own lovely excellent body,

verses.sanskrit: चिन्तामभ्येत्य भगवांस्त्रिकालामलदर्शनः । एतस्मिन्परमाकाशे चिन्मात्रैकात्मरूपिणी
verses.transliteration: cintāmabhyetya bhagavāṃstrikālāmaladarśanaḥ | etasminparamākāśe cinmātraikātmarūpiṇī
verses.translation: the Lord, with spotless sight of the three times, falls to thought: "In this supreme space, in the form of the one Self of pure consciousness,

verses.sanskrit: अदृष्टपारपर्यन्ते प्रथमं किं भवेदिति । इति चिन्तितवान्ब्रह्मा सद्यो जातामलात्मदृक्
verses.transliteration: adṛṣṭapāraparyante prathamaṃ kiṃ bhavediti | iti cintitavānbrahmā sadyo jātāmalātmadṛk
verses.translation: at the unseen far end, what would be first?" Thus Brahma thought, immediately having the vision of the spotless Self.

verses.sanskrit: अपश्यत्सर्गवृन्दानि समतीतान्यनेकशः । स्मरत्यथो स सकलान्सर्वधर्मगुणक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: apaśyatsargavṛndāni samatītānyanekaśaḥ | smaratyatho sa sakalānsarvadharmaguṇakramāt
verses.translation: He saw groups of creations gone by, many times; then he remembered all, in order of all laws and qualities.

verses.sanskrit: लीलया कल्पयामास चित्राः संकल्पतः प्रजाः । नानाचारसमारम्भा गन्धर्वनगरं यथा
verses.transliteration: līlayā kalpayāmāsa citrāḥ saṃkalpataḥ prajāḥ | nānācārasamārambhā gandharvanagaraṃ yathā
verses.translation: Playfully he imagined by intention various creatures, with varied conduct and undertakings, like a city of Gandharvas.

verses.sanskrit: तासां स्वर्गापवर्गार्थं धर्मकामार्थसिद्धये । अनन्तानि विचित्राणि शास्त्राणि समकल्पयत्
verses.transliteration: tāsāṃ svargāpavargārthaṃ dharmakāmārthasiddhaye | anantāni vicitrāṇi śāstrāṇi samakalpayat
verses.translation: For them, for heaven and liberation, for the accomplishment of dharma, desire and wealth, he arranged endless varied scriptures.

verses.sanskrit: विरञ्चिरूपान्मनसः कल्पितत्वाज्जगत्स्थितेः । तावत्स्थितिरियं प्रोक्ता तन्नाशे नाशमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: virañcirūpānmanasaḥ kalpitatvājjagatsthiteḥ | tāvatsthitiriyaṃ proktā tannāśe nāśamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Because it is imagined by the mind in the form of Virinchi, the world's continuance is declared to last that long; when that is destroyed, it would be destroyed.

verses.sanskrit: न जायते न म्रियते क्वचित्किंचित्कदाचन । परमार्थेन विप्रेन्द्र मिथ्या सर्वं तु दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: na jāyate na mriyate kvacitkiṃcitkadācana | paramārthena viprendra mithyā sarvaṃ tu dṛśyate
verses.translation: Nothing is ever born or dies anywhere at any time; in ultimate truth, O best of Brahmins, all that is seen is false.

verses.sanskrit: कोशमाशाभुजङ्गानां संसाराडंबरं त्यज । असदेतदिति ज्ञात्वा मातृभावं निवेशय
verses.transliteration: kośamāśābhujaṅgānāṃ saṃsārāḍaṃbaraṃ tyaja | asadetaditi jñātvā mātṛbhāvaṃ niveśaya
verses.translation: Abandon the sheath of the serpents of hope, the pomp of the world; knowing "this is unreal," settle in the attitude of a mother.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वनगरस्यार्थे भूषितेऽभूषिते तथा । अविद्यांशे सुतादौ वा कः क्रमः सुखदुःखयोः
verses.transliteration: gandharvanagarasyārthe bhūṣite'bhūṣite tathā | avidyāṃśe sutādau vā kaḥ kramaḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ
verses.translation: For a city of Gandharvas, adorned or unadorned, or in a portion of ignorance, sons and the like — what order is there of pleasure and pain?

verses.sanskrit: धनदारेषु वृद्धेषु दुःखयुक्तं न तुष्टता । वृद्धायां मोहमायायां कः समाश्वासवानिह
verses.transliteration: dhanadāreṣu vṛddheṣu duḥkhayuktaṃ na tuṣṭatā | vṛddhāyāṃ mohamāyāyāṃ kaḥ samāśvāsavāniha
verses.translation: When wealth and wives increase there is pain, not contentment; when the illusion of delusion grows, who here has comfort?

verses.sanskrit: यैरेव जायते रागो मूर्खस्याधिकतां गतैः । तैरेव भागैः प्राज्ञस्य विराग उपजायते
verses.transliteration: yaireva jāyate rāgo mūrkhasyādhikatāṃ gataiḥ | taireva bhāgaiḥ prājñasya virāga upajāyate
verses.translation: By the same things by which attachment arises in the fool, grown strong, by those same portions dispassion arises in the wise.

verses.sanskrit: अतो निदाघ तत्त्वज्ञ व्यवहारेषु संसृतेः । नष्टं नष्टमुपेक्षस्व प्राप्तं प्राप्तमुपाहर
verses.transliteration: ato nidāgha tattvajña vyavahāreṣu saṃsṛteḥ | naṣṭaṃ naṣṭamupekṣasva prāptaṃ prāptamupāhara
verses.translation: Therefore, Nidagha, knower of truth, in the dealings of the world, ignore what is lost, lost; take what is obtained, obtained.

verses.sanskrit: अनागतानां भोगानामवाञ्छनमकृत्रिमम् । आगतानां च संभोग
verses.transliteration: anāgatānāṃ bhogānāmavāñchanamakṛtrimam | āgatānāṃ ca saṃbhoga
verses.translation: Natural non-wishing for pleasures not yet come, and for those that come, enjoyment —

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धं सदसतोर्मध्यं पदं बुद्ध्वावलंब्य च । सबाह्याभ्यन्तरं दृश्यं मा गृहाण विमुञ्च मा
verses.transliteration: śuddhaṃ sadasatormadhyaṃ padaṃ buddhvāvalaṃbya ca | sabāhyābhyantaraṃ dṛśyaṃ mā gṛhāṇa vimuñca mā
verses.translation: having understood and relying on the pure state between existence and non-existence, do not grasp the seen, outer and inner, and do not reject it.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य चेच्छा तथानिच्छा ज्ञस्य कर्मणि तिष्ठतः । न तस्य लिप्यते प्रज्ञा पद्मपत्रमिवाम्बुभिः
verses.transliteration: yasya cecchā tathānicchā jñasya karmaṇi tiṣṭhataḥ | na tasya lipyate prajñā padmapatramivāmbubhiḥ
verses.translation: He whose desire and non-desire are alike, the knower abiding in action — his insight is not tainted, like a lotus leaf by water.

verses.sanskrit: यदि ते नेन्द्रियार्थश्रीः स्पन्दते हृदि वै द्विज । तदा विज्ञातविज्ञेया समुत्तीर्णो भवार्णवात्
verses.transliteration: yadi te nendriyārthaśrīḥ spandate hṛdi vai dvija | tadā vijñātavijñeyā samuttīrṇo bhavārṇavāt
verses.translation: If the splendor of sense-objects does not stir in your heart, O twice-born, then, having known the knowable, you have crossed the ocean of becoming.

verses.sanskrit: उच्चैःपदाय परया प्रज्ञया वासनागणात् । पुष्पाद्गन्धमपोह्यारं चेतोवृत्तिं पृथक्कुरु
verses.transliteration: uccaiḥpadāya parayā prajñayā vāsanāgaṇāt | puṣpādgandhamapohyāraṃ cetovṛttiṃ pṛthakkuru
verses.translation: For the high state, by supreme insight separate the mind's modification from the host of impressions, as one removes scent from a flower.

verses.sanskrit: संसाराम्बुनिधावस्मिन्वासनाम्बुपरिप्लुते । ये प्रज्ञानावमारूढास्ते तीर्णाः पण्डिताः परे
verses.transliteration: saṃsārāmbunidhāvasminvāsanāmbupariplute | ye prajñānāvamārūḍhāste tīrṇāḥ paṇḍitāḥ pare
verses.translation: In this ocean of the world flooded with the water of impressions, those who have climbed the boat of knowledge are crossed over — the supreme wise.

verses.sanskrit: न त्यजन्ति न वाञ्छन्ति व्यवहारं जगद्गतम् । सर्वमेवानुवर्तन्ते पारावारविदो जनाः
verses.transliteration: na tyajanti na vāñchanti vyavahāraṃ jagadgatam | sarvamevānuvartante pārāvāravido janāḥ
verses.translation: Those who know both shores neither abandon nor wish for dealings in the world; they follow all of it.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तस्यात्मतत्त्वस्य सत्तासामान्यरूपिणः । चितश्चेत्योन्मुखत्वं यत्तत्संकल्पाङ्कुरं विदुः
verses.transliteration: anantasyātmatattvasya sattāsāmānyarūpiṇaḥ | citaścetyonmukhatvaṃ yattatsaṃkalpāṅkuraṃ viduḥ
verses.translation: Of the infinite principle of the Self, of the form of common being, the turning of consciousness toward the perceived is known as the sprout of intention.

verses.sanskrit: लेशतः प्राप्तसत्ताकः स एव घनतां शनैः । याति चित्तत्वमापूर्य दृढं जाड्याय मेघवत्
verses.transliteration: leśataḥ prāptasattākaḥ sa eva ghanatāṃ śanaiḥ | yāti cittatvamāpūrya dṛḍhaṃ jāḍyāya meghavat
verses.translation: That which has obtained a trace of being slowly becomes dense, filling out mindhood firmly, for dullness, like a cloud.

verses.sanskrit: भावयन्ति चितिश्चैत्यं व्यतिरिक्तमिवात्मनः । संकल्पतामिवायाति बीजमङ्कुरतामिव
verses.transliteration: bhāvayanti citiścaityaṃ vyatiriktamivātmanaḥ | saṃkalpatāmivāyāti bījamaṅkuratāmiva
verses.translation: They contemplate the perceived as if separate from consciousness itself; it becomes like intention, like a seed becoming a sprout.

verses.sanskrit: संकल्पनं हि संकल्पः स्वयमेव प्रजायते । वर्धते स्वयमेवाशु दुःखाय न सुखाय यत्
verses.transliteration: saṃkalpanaṃ hi saṃkalpaḥ svayameva prajāyate | vardhate svayamevāśu duḥkhāya na sukhāya yat
verses.translation: Intention itself is born of itself and grows quickly of itself, for sorrow and not for happiness.

verses.sanskrit: मा संकल्पय संकल्पं मा भावं भावय स्थितौ । संकल्पनाशने यत्तो न भूयोऽननुगच्छति
verses.transliteration: mā saṃkalpaya saṃkalpaṃ mā bhāvaṃ bhāvaya sthitau | saṃkalpanāśane yatto na bhūyo'nanugacchati
verses.translation: Do not form intentions; do not contemplate a notion in what stands; strive for the destruction of intention, after which it does not follow again.

verses.sanskrit: भावनाभावमात्रेण संकल्पः क्षीयते स्वयम् । संकल्पेनैव संकल्पं मनसैव मनो मुने
verses.transliteration: bhāvanābhāvamātreṇa saṃkalpaḥ kṣīyate svayam | saṃkalpenaiva saṃkalpaṃ manasaiva mano mune
verses.translation: By mere non-contemplation, intention dwindles of itself; cutting intention with intention itself, O sage, the mind with the mind,

verses.sanskrit: छित्त्वा स्वात्मनि तिष्ठ त्वं किमेतावति दुष्करम् । यथैवेदं नभः शून्यं जगच्छून्यं तथैव हि
verses.transliteration: chittvā svātmani tiṣṭha tvaṃ kimetāvati duṣkaram | yathaivedaṃ nabhaḥ śūnyaṃ jagacchūnyaṃ tathaiva hi
verses.translation: stay in your own Self; what is difficult in this? As this sky is void, so indeed is the world void.

verses.sanskrit: तण्डुलस्य यथा चर्म यथा ताम्रस्य कालिमा । नश्यति क्रियया विप्र पुरुषस्य तथा मलम्
verses.transliteration: taṇḍulasya yathā carma yathā tāmrasya kālimā | naśyati kriyayā vipra puruṣasya tathā malam
verses.translation: As the husk of rice and the blackness of copper are destroyed by action, O Brahmin, so is the stain of a person.

verses.sanskrit: जीवस्य तण्डुलस्येव मलं सहजमप्यलम् । नश्यत्येव न सन्देहस्तस्मादुद्योगवान्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: jīvasya taṇḍulasyeva malaṃ sahajamapyalam | naśyatyeva na sandehastasmādudyogavānbhavet
verses.translation: The stain of the individual, like that of rice, though innate, is also destroyed without doubt; therefore be energetic.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तरास्थां परित्यज्य भावश्रीं भावनामयीम् । योऽसि सोऽसि जगत्यस्मिंल्लीलया विहरानघ
verses.transliteration: antarāsthāṃ parityajya bhāvaśrīṃ bhāvanāmayīm | yo'si so'si jagatyasmiṃllīlayā viharānagha
verses.translation: Giving up inner reliance on the glory of notions made of contemplation, whoever you are, you are; wander playfully in this world, sinless one.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वत्राहमकर्तेति दृढभावनयानया । परमामृतनाम्नी सा समतैवावशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: sarvatrāhamakarteti dṛḍhabhāvanayānayā | paramāmṛtanāmnī sā samataivāvaśiṣyate
verses.translation: By this firm contemplation "everywhere I am a non-doer," that evenness named supreme nectar alone remains.

verses.sanskrit: खेदोल्लासविलासेषु स्वात्मकर्तृतयैकया । स्वसंकल्पे क्षयं याते समतैवावशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: khedollāsavilāseṣu svātmakartṛtayaikayā | svasaṃkalpe kṣayaṃ yāte samataivāvaśiṣyate
verses.translation: In sorrow, joy and sport, by seeing oneself alone as doer, when one's own intention is destroyed, evenness alone remains.

verses.sanskrit: समता सर्वभावेषु यासौ सत्यपरा स्थितिः । तस्यामवस्थितं चित्तं न भूयो जन्मभाग्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: samatā sarvabhāveṣu yāsau satyaparā sthitiḥ | tasyāmavasthitaṃ cittaṃ na bhūyo janmabhāgbhavet
verses.translation: That evenness in all states, which is the supreme true condition — the mind abiding in it does not again take birth.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा सर्वकर्तृत्वमकर्तृत्वं च वै मुने । सर्वं त्यक्त्वा मनः पीत्वा योऽसि सोऽसि स्थिरो भव
verses.transliteration: athavā sarvakartṛtvamakartṛtvaṃ ca vai mune | sarvaṃ tyaktvā manaḥ pītvā yo'si so'si sthiro bhava
verses.translation: Or, O sage, giving up both all-doership and non-doership, drinking up the mind, whoever you are, you are; be steady.

verses.sanskrit: शेषस्थिरो समाधानो येन त्यजसि तत्त्यज । चिन्मनःकलनाकारं प्रकाशतिमिरादिकम्
verses.transliteration: śeṣasthiro samādhāno yena tyajasi tattyaja | cinmanaḥkalanākāraṃ prakāśatimirādikam
verses.translation: Steady in the remainder and in concentration, give up that by which you give up; the form of consciousness and mind's imagining, light and darkness and the like.

verses.sanskrit: वासनां वासितारं च प्राणस्पन्दनपूर्वकम् । समूलमखिलं त्यक्त्वा व्योमसाम्यः प्रशान्तधीः
verses.transliteration: vāsanāṃ vāsitāraṃ ca prāṇaspandanapūrvakam | samūlamakhilaṃ tyaktvā vyomasāmyaḥ praśāntadhīḥ
verses.translation: Impressions and the one who is impressed, preceded by the vibration of life-breath, abandoning all with its root, equal to the sky, of quiet mind,

verses.sanskrit: हृदयात्सम्परित्यज्य सर्ववासनपङ्क्तयः । यस्तिष्ठति गतव्यग्रः स मुक्तः परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: hṛdayātsamparityajya sarvavāsanapaṅktayaḥ | yastiṣṭhati gatavyagraḥ sa muktaḥ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: abandoning from the heart all rows of impressions, he who stays free of agitation is liberated, the Supreme Lord.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टं द्रष्टव्यमखिलं भ्रान्तं भ्रान्त्या दिशो दश । युक्त्या वै चरतो ज्ञस्य संसारो गोष्पदाकृतिः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭaṃ draṣṭavyamakhilaṃ bhrāntaṃ bhrāntyā diśo daśa | yuktyā vai carato jñasya saṃsāro goṣpadākṛtiḥ
verses.translation: All that is seen and to be seen is wandering; by delusion the ten directions; for the wise one acting with reason, the world has the shape of a cow's hoofprint.

verses.sanskrit: सबाह्याभ्यन्तरे देहे ह्यध ऊर्ध्वं च दिक्षु च । इत आत्मा ततोऽप्यात्मा नास्त्यनात्ममयं जगत्
verses.transliteration: sabāhyābhyantare dehe hyadha ūrdhvaṃ ca dikṣu ca | ita ātmā tato'pyātmā nāstyanātmamayaṃ jagat
verses.translation: In the body, outer and inner, below, above and in all directions, here the Self, there too the Self; there is no world made of the non-Self.

verses.sanskrit: न तदस्ति न यत्राहं न तदस्ति न तन्मयम् । किमन्यदभिवाञ्छामि सर्वं सच्चिन्मयं ततम्
verses.transliteration: na tadasti na yatrāhaṃ na tadasti na tanmayam | kimanyadabhivāñchāmi sarvaṃ saccinmayaṃ tatam
verses.translation: There is nothing where I am not; there is nothing not made of it; what else would I wish for? All is spread out, made of being-consciousness.

verses.sanskrit: समस्तं खल्विदं ब्रह्म सर्वमात्मेदमाततम् । अहमन्य इदं चान्यदिति भ्रान्तिं त्यजानघ
verses.transliteration: samastaṃ khalvidaṃ brahma sarvamātmedamātatam | ahamanya idaṃ cānyaditi bhrāntiṃ tyajānagha
verses.translation: All this is indeed Brahman; all this is spread out as the Self; abandon, sinless one, the delusion "I am one, this is another."

verses.sanskrit: तते ब्रह्मघने नित्ये संभवन्ति न कल्पिताः । न शोकोऽस्ति न मोहोऽस्ति न जरास्ति न जन्म वा
verses.transliteration: tate brahmaghane nitye saṃbhavanti na kalpitāḥ | na śoko'sti na moho'sti na jarāsti na janma vā
verses.translation: In the extended, dense Brahman, eternal, imagined things do not arise; there is no grief, no delusion, no old age or birth.

verses.sanskrit: यदस्तीह तदेवास्ति विज्वरो भव सर्वदा । यथाप्राप्तानुभवतः सर्वत्रानभिवाञ्छनात्
verses.transliteration: yadastīha tadevāsti vijvaro bhava sarvadā | yathāprāptānubhavataḥ sarvatrānabhivāñchanāt
verses.translation: What exists here, that alone exists; be free of fever always; by experiencing what comes as it comes, by not longing anywhere.

verses.sanskrit: त्यागादानपरित्यागी विज्वरो भव सर्वदा । यस्येदं जन्म पाश्चात्यं तमाश्वेव महामते
verses.transliteration: tyāgādānaparityāgī vijvaro bhava sarvadā | yasyedaṃ janma pāścātyaṃ tamāśveva mahāmate
verses.translation: Renouncing giving up and taking, be free of fever always; for whoever has this last birth, O great-minded, to him swiftly

verses.sanskrit: विशन्ति विद्या विमला मुक्ता वेणुमिवोत्तमम् । विरक्तमनसां सम्यक्स्वप्रसङ्गादुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: viśanti vidyā vimalā muktā veṇumivottamam | viraktamanasāṃ samyaksvaprasaṅgādudāhṛtam
verses.translation: pure knowledge enters, like a pearl into the best bamboo; this has been declared by one's own experience for those of dispassionate mind.

verses.sanskrit: द्रष्टुर्दृश्यसमायोगात्प्रत्ययानन्दनिश्चयः । यस्तं स्वमात्मतत्त्वोत्थं निष्पन्दं समुपास्महे
verses.transliteration: draṣṭurdṛśyasamāyogātpratyayānandaniścayaḥ | yastaṃ svamātmatattvotthaṃ niṣpandaṃ samupāsmahe
verses.translation: From the union of the seer with the seen arises the certainty of the delight of cognition; we worship that unvibrating one that arises from the principle of one's own Self.

verses.sanskrit: द्रष्टृदर्शनदृश्यानि त्यक्त्वा वासनया सह । दर्शनप्रत्ययाभासमात्मानं समुपास्महे
verses.transliteration: draṣṭṛdarśanadṛśyāni tyaktvā vāsanayā saha | darśanapratyayābhāsamātmānaṃ samupāsmahe
verses.translation: Giving up seer, seeing and seen together with impressions, we worship the Self that appears as the cognition of seeing.

verses.sanskrit: द्वयोर्मध्यगतं नित्यमस्तिनास्तीति पक्षयोः । प्रकाशनं प्रकाशानामात्मानं समुपास्महे
verses.transliteration: dvayormadhyagataṃ nityamastināstīti pakṣayoḥ | prakāśanaṃ prakāśānāmātmānaṃ samupāsmahe
verses.translation: We worship the Self, ever in the middle of the two sides "it is" and "it is not," the illuminator of lights.

verses.sanskrit: सन्त्यज्य हृद्गुहेशानं देवमन्यं प्रयान्ति ये । ते रत्नमभिवाञ्छन्ति त्यक्तहस्तस्थकौस्तुभाः
verses.transliteration: santyajya hṛdguheśānaṃ devamanyaṃ prayānti ye | te ratnamabhivāñchanti tyaktahastasthakaustubhāḥ
verses.translation: Those who abandon the god, the Lord in the cave of the heart, and go to another, seek a jewel having thrown away the Kaustubha in hand.

verses.sanskrit: उत्थितानुत्थितानेतानिन्द्रियारीन्पुनः पुनः । हन्याद्विवेकदण्डेन वज्रेणेव हरिर्गिरीन्
verses.transliteration: utthitānutthitānetānindriyārīnpunaḥ punaḥ | hanyādvivekadaṇḍena vajreṇeva harirgirīn
verses.translation: One should strike these enemies, the senses, again and again, whether risen or not risen, with the staff of discrimination, as Hari struck the mountains with the thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit: संसाररात्रिदुःस्वप्ने शून्ये देहमये भ्रमे । सर्वमेवापवित्रं तद्दृष्टं संसृतिविभ्रमम्
verses.transliteration: saṃsārarātriduḥsvapne śūnye dehamaye bhrame | sarvamevāpavitraṃ taddṛṣṭaṃ saṃsṛtivibhramam
verses.translation: In the bad dream of the night of the world, in the void delusion made of the body, all that seen is impure — the confusion of worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञानोपहतो बाल्ये यौवने वनिताहतः । शेषे कलत्रचिन्तार्तः किं करोति नराधमः
verses.transliteration: ajñānopahato bālye yauvane vanitāhataḥ | śeṣe kalatracintārtaḥ kiṃ karoti narādhamaḥ
verses.translation: Struck by ignorance in childhood, by women in youth, and tormented by anxiety for his wife in the rest, what does the lowest of men do?

verses.sanskrit: सतोऽसत्ता स्थिता मूर्ध्नि रम्याणां मूर्ध्न्यरम्यता । सुखानां मूर्ध्निदुःखानि किमेकं संश्रयाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: sato'sattā sthitā mūrdhni ramyāṇāṃ mūrdhnyaramyatā | sukhānāṃ mūrdhniduḥkhāni kimekaṃ saṃśrayāmyaham
verses.translation: Non-being stands at the head of being, unloveliness at the head of the lovely, sorrows at the head of pleasures; in which one shall I take refuge?

verses.sanskrit: येषां निमेषणामेषौ जगतः प्रलयोदयौ । तादृशाः पुरुषा यान्ति मादृशां गणनैव का
verses.transliteration: yeṣāṃ nimeṣaṇāmeṣau jagataḥ pralayodayau | tādṛśāḥ puruṣā yānti mādṛśāṃ gaṇanaiva kā
verses.translation: Those persons whose opening and closing of the eyelids is the world's dissolution and arising — such persons pass away; what is the counting of ones like me?

verses.sanskrit: संसार एव दुःखानां सीमान्त इति कथ्यते । तन्मध्ये पतिते देहे सुखमासाद्यते कथम्
verses.transliteration: saṃsāra eva duḥkhānāṃ sīmānta iti kathyate | tanmadhye patite dehe sukhamāsādyate katham
verses.translation: The world itself is said to be the limit of sorrows; how can happiness be gained in the body fallen in its midst?

verses.sanskrit: प्रबुद्धोऽस्मि प्रबुद्धोऽस्मि दुष्टश्चोरोऽयमात्मनः । मनो नाम निहन्म्येनं मनसास्मि चिरं हृतः
verses.transliteration: prabuddho'smi prabuddho'smi duṣṭaścoro'yamātmanaḥ | mano nāma nihanmyenaṃ manasāsmi ciraṃ hṛtaḥ
verses.translation: I am awakened, I am awakened! This is the wicked thief of the Self; I shall kill it, the mind; by the mind I have long been robbed.

verses.sanskrit: मा खेदं भज हेयेषु नोपादेयपरो भव । हेयादेयादृशौ त्यक्त्वा शेषस्थः सुस्थिरो भव
verses.transliteration: mā khedaṃ bhaja heyeṣu nopādeyaparo bhava | heyādeyādṛśau tyaktvā śeṣasthaḥ susthiro bhava
verses.translation: Do not grieve over what is to be abandoned; do not be intent on what is to be taken; abandoning the views of abandoning and taking, abide in the remainder and be steady.

verses.sanskrit: निराशता निर्भयता नित्यता समता ज्ञता । निरीहता निष्क्रियता सौम्यता निर्विकल्पता
verses.transliteration: nirāśatā nirbhayatā nityatā samatā jñatā | nirīhatā niṣkriyatā saumyatā nirvikalpatā
verses.translation: Hopelessness, fearlessness, constancy, evenness, knowledge, desirelessness, actionlessness, gentleness, freedom from conceptions;

verses.sanskrit: धृर्मैत्री मनस्तुष्टिर्मृदुता मृदुभाषिता । हेयोपादेयनिर्मुक्ते ज्ञे तिष्ठन्त्यपवासनम्
verses.transliteration: dhṛrmaitrī manastuṣṭirmṛdutā mṛdubhāṣitā | heyopādeyanirmukte jñe tiṣṭhantyapavāsanam
verses.translation: firmness, friendliness, contentment of mind, softness, soft speech — these abide without impression in the knower freed from abandoning and taking.

verses.sanskrit: गृहीततृष्णाशबरीवासनाजालमाततम् । संसारवारिप्रसृतं चिन्तातन्तुभिराततम्
verses.transliteration: gṛhītatṛṣṇāśabarīvāsanājālamātatam | saṃsāravāriprasṛtaṃ cintātantubhirātatam
verses.translation: The net of impressions, spread by the huntress craving who has seized, extended by the threads of anxiety, flowing in the water of the world:

verses.sanskrit: अनया तीक्ष्णया तात छिन्धि बुद्धिशलाकया । वात्ययेवाम्बुदं जालं छित्त्वा तिष्ठ तते पदे
verses.transliteration: anayā tīkṣṇayā tāta chindhi buddhiśalākayā | vātyayevāmbudaṃ jālaṃ chittvā tiṣṭha tate pade
verses.translation: cut this, dear one, with this sharp needle of intellect; having cut the net as wind a cloud, stand in the extended state.

verses.sanskrit: मनसैव मनश्छित्त्वा कुठारेणेव पादपम् । पदं पावनमासाद्य सद्य एव स्थिरो भव
verses.transliteration: manasaiva manaśchittvā kuṭhāreṇeva pādapam | padaṃ pāvanamāsādya sadya eva sthiro bhava
verses.translation: Cutting the mind with the mind alone, like a tree with an axe, reach the purifying state and be steady at once.

verses.sanskrit: तिष्ठन्गच्छन्त्स्वपञ्जाग्रन्निवसन्नुत्पतन्पतन् । असदेवेदमित्यन्तं निश्चित्यास्तां परित्यज
verses.transliteration: tiṣṭhangacchantsvapañjāgrannivasannutpatanpatan | asadevedamityantaṃ niścityāstāṃ parityaja
verses.translation: Standing, going, sleeping, waking, dwelling, rising, falling — having ascertained to the end "this is unreal," abandon it.

verses.sanskrit: दृश्यमाश्रयसीदं चेत्तत्सच्चितोऽसि बन्धवान् । दृश्यं सन्त्यजसीदं चेत्तदाऽचित्तोऽसि मोक्षवान्
verses.transliteration: dṛśyamāśrayasīdaṃ cettatsaccito'si bandhavān | dṛśyaṃ santyajasīdaṃ cettadā'citto'si mokṣavān
verses.translation: If you take refuge in this seen, you are a conscious being, bound; if you abandon this seen, then you are mindless, liberated.

verses.sanskrit: नाहं नेदमिति ध्यायंस्तिष्ठ त्वमचलाचलः । आत्मनो जगतश्चान्तर्द्रष्टृदृश्यदशान्तरे
verses.transliteration: nāhaṃ nedamiti dhyāyaṃstiṣṭha tvamacalācalaḥ | ātmano jagataścāntardraṣṭṛdṛśyadaśāntare
verses.translation: Meditating "I am not, this is not," stay immovable, within the Self and the world, in the interval between seer and seen.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शनाख्यं स्वमात्मानं सर्वदा भावयन्भव । स्वाद्यस्वादकसंत्यक्तं स्वाद्यस्वादकमध्यगम्
verses.transliteration: darśanākhyaṃ svamātmānaṃ sarvadā bhāvayanbhava | svādyasvādakasaṃtyaktaṃ svādyasvādakamadhyagam
verses.translation: Ever contemplate your own Self called seeing; free of taster and tasted, in the middle of taster and tasted,

verses.sanskrit: स्वदनं केवलं ध्यायन्परमात्ममयो भव । अवलम्ब्य निरालम्बं मध्येमध्ये स्थिरो भव
verses.transliteration: svadanaṃ kevalaṃ dhyāyanparamātmamayo bhava | avalambya nirālambaṃ madhyemadhye sthiro bhava
verses.translation: meditating on mere tasting, become of the Supreme Self; relying on the unsupported, in the midst be steady.

verses.sanskrit: रज्जुबद्धा विमुच्यन्ते तृष्णाबद्धा न केनचित् । तस्मान्निदाघ तृष्णा त्वं त्यज संकल्पवर्जनात्
verses.transliteration: rajjubaddhā vimucyante tṛṣṇābaddhā na kenacit | tasmānnidāgha tṛṣṇā tvaṃ tyaja saṃkalpavarjanāt
verses.translation: Those bound by rope are freed; those bound by craving are not freed by anyone; therefore, Nidagha, abandon craving by giving up intention.

verses.sanskrit: एतामहंभावमयीपपुण्यां छित्त्वानहंभाव शलाकयैव ॥ स्वभावजां भव्यभवन्तभूमौ भव प्रशान्ताखिलभूतभीतिः
verses.transliteration: etāmahaṃbhāvamayīpapuṇyāṃ chittvānahaṃbhāva śalākayaiva || svabhāvajāṃ bhavyabhavantabhūmau bhava praśāntākhilabhūtabhītiḥ
verses.translation: Cutting this impure one made of I-sense with the needle of non-I-sense, born of nature, in the ground of becoming, become one whose fear of all beings is quieted.

verses.sanskrit: अहमेषां पदार्थानामेते च मम जीवितम् । नाहमेभिर्विना किंचिन्न मयैते विना किल
verses.transliteration: ahameṣāṃ padārthānāmete ca mama jīvitam | nāhamebhirvinā kiṃcinna mayaite vinā kila
verses.translation: "I belong to these things and they are my life; I am nothing without them, nor are they without me" —

verses.sanskrit: इत्यन्तर्निश्चयं त्यक्त्वा विचार्य मनसा सह । नाहं पदार्थस्य न मे पदार्थ
verses.transliteration: ityantarniścayaṃ tyaktvā vicārya manasā saha | nāhaṃ padārthasya na me padārtha
verses.translation: abandoning such inner conviction, reflecting with the mind: "I am not of a thing; no thing is mine."

verses.sanskrit: अन्तःशीतलया बुद्ध्या कुर्वतो लीलया क्रियाम् । यो नूनं वासनात्यागो ध्येयो ब्रह्मन्प्रकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: antaḥśītalayā buddhyā kurvato līlayā kriyām | yo nūnaṃ vāsanātyāgo dhyeyo brahmanprakīrtitaḥ
verses.translation: For one doing action playfully with an inwardly cool mind, that abandonment of impressions, O Brahmin, is declared to be the aim.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं समतया बुद्ध्या यः कृत्वा वासनाक्षयम् । जहाति निर्ममो देहं नेयोऽसौ वासनाक्षयः
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ samatayā buddhyā yaḥ kṛtvā vāsanākṣayam | jahāti nirmamo dehaṃ neyo'sau vāsanākṣayaḥ
verses.translation: He who, having made all things equal by intellect and destroyed impressions, leaves the body without possessiveness — his destruction of impressions is the one to be known.

verses.sanskrit: अहंकारमयीं त्यक्त्वा वासनां लीलयैव यः । तिष्ठति ध्येयसंत्यागी स जीवन्मुक्त उच्यते
verses.transliteration: ahaṃkāramayīṃ tyaktvā vāsanāṃ līlayaiva yaḥ | tiṣṭhati dhyeyasaṃtyāgī sa jīvanmukta ucyate
verses.translation: He who has playfully given up impressions made of egoism and stays as a renouncer of objects of meditation is called liberated while living.

verses.sanskrit: निर्मूलं कलनां त्यक्त्वा वासनां यः शमं गतः । ज्ञेयं त्यागमिमं विद्धि मुक्तं तं ब्राह्मणोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nirmūlaṃ kalanāṃ tyaktvā vāsanāṃ yaḥ śamaṃ gataḥ | jñeyaṃ tyāgamimaṃ viddhi muktaṃ taṃ brāhmaṇottamam
verses.translation: He who, having abandoned imagining and impressions without root, has attained peace — know this renunciation to be known: he is liberated, best of Brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: द्वावेतौ ब्रह्मतां यातौ द्वावेतौ विगतज्वरौ । आपतत्सु यथाकालं सुखदुःखेष्वनारतौ । संन्यासियोगिनौ दान्तौ विद्धि शान्तौ मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: dvāvetau brahmatāṃ yātau dvāvetau vigatajvarau | āpatatsu yathākālaṃ sukhaduḥkheṣvanāratau | saṃnyāsiyoginau dāntau viddhi śāntau munīśvara
verses.translation: These two have attained Brahman-hood, these two are free of fever; unwearied in pleasures and pains that arrive at their time; know these, renouncer and yogi, self-controlled and peaceful, O lord of sages.

verses.sanskrit: ईप्सितानीप्सिते न स्तो यस्यान्तर्वर्तिदृष्टिषु । सुषुप्तवद्यश्चरति स जीवन्मुक्त उच्यते
verses.transliteration: īpsitānīpsite na sto yasyāntarvartidṛṣṭiṣu | suṣuptavadyaścarati sa jīvanmukta ucyate
verses.translation: For whom there are no desired or undesired things in the views within, who acts as in deep sleep — he is called liberated while living.

verses.sanskrit: हर्षामर्षभयक्रोधकामकार्पण्यदृष्टिभिः । न हृष्यति ग्लायति यः परामर्शविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: harṣāmarṣabhayakrodhakāmakārpaṇyadṛṣṭibhiḥ | na hṛṣyati glāyati yaḥ parāmarśavivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: Who does not rejoice or sink through views of joy, anger, fear, wrath, desire or meanness, free of reflection;

verses.sanskrit: बाह्यार्थवासनोद्भूता तृष्णा बद्धेति कथ्यते । सर्वार्थवासनोन्मुक्ता तृष्णा मुक्तेति भण्यते
verses.transliteration: bāhyārthavāsanodbhūtā tṛṣṇā baddheti kathyate | sarvārthavāsanonmuktā tṛṣṇā mukteti bhaṇyate
verses.translation: craving born of impressions of outer objects is called bound; craving freed from impressions of all objects is called free.

verses.sanskrit: इदमस्तु ममेत्यन्तमिच्छां प्रार्थनयान्विताम् । तां तीक्ष्णां शृङ्खलां विद्धि दुःखजन्मभयप्रदाम्
verses.transliteration: idamastu mametyantamicchāṃ prārthanayānvitām | tāṃ tīkṣṇāṃ śṛṅkhalāṃ viddhi duḥkhajanmabhayapradām
verses.translation: "Let this be mine" — know that desire, accompanied by prayer, to be a sharp chain giving sorrow, birth and fear.

verses.sanskrit: तामेतां सर्वभावेषु सत्स्वसत्सु च सर्वदा । संत्यज्य परमोदारं पदमेति महामनाः
verses.transliteration: tāmetāṃ sarvabhāveṣu satsvasatsu ca sarvadā | saṃtyajya paramodāraṃ padameti mahāmanāḥ
verses.translation: The great-minded one, always abandoning this in all states, existent and non-existent, reaches the supremely noble state.

verses.sanskrit: बन्धास्थामथ मोक्षास्थां सुखदुःखदशामपि । त्यक्त्वा सदसदास्थां त्वं तिष्ठाक्षुब्धमहाब्धिवत्
verses.transliteration: bandhāsthāmatha mokṣāsthāṃ sukhaduḥkhadaśāmapi | tyaktvā sadasadāsthāṃ tvaṃ tiṣṭhākṣubdhamahābdhivat
verses.translation: Abandoning reliance on bondage and on liberation, even on the state of pleasure and pain, and reliance on being and non-being, stay like an unagitated great ocean.

verses.sanskrit: जायते निश्चयः साधो पुरुषस्य चतुर्विधः
verses.transliteration: jāyate niścayaḥ sādho puruṣasya caturvidhaḥ
verses.translation: O good man, a fourfold conviction arises in a person.

verses.sanskrit: आपादमस्तकमहं मातापितृविनिर्मितः । इत्येको निश्चयो ब्रह्मन्बन्धायासविलोकनात्
verses.transliteration: āpādamastakamahaṃ mātāpitṛvinirmitaḥ | ityeko niścayo brahmanbandhāyāsavilokanāt
verses.translation: "I am from foot to head made by mother and father" — this is the first conviction, O Brahmin, seen from the toil of bondage.

verses.sanskrit: अतीतः सर्वभावेभ्यो वालाग्रादप्यहं तनुः । इति द्वितीयो मोक्षाय निश्चयो जायते सताम्
verses.transliteration: atītaḥ sarvabhāvebhyo vālāgrādapyahaṃ tanuḥ | iti dvitīyo mokṣāya niścayo jāyate satām
verses.translation: "I am beyond all states, subtler than a hair's tip" — this is the second conviction that arises in the good for liberation.

verses.sanskrit: जगज्जाल पदार्थात्मा सर्व एवाहमक्षयः । तृतीयो निश्चयश्चोक्तो मोक्षायैव द्विजोत्तम
verses.transliteration: jagajjāla padārthātmā sarva evāhamakṣayaḥ | tṛtīyo niścayaścokto mokṣāyaiva dvijottama
verses.translation: "I am the net of the world, the whole of the Self of things, imperishable" — the third conviction is said, best of Brahmins, for liberation alone.

verses.sanskrit: अहं जगद्वा सकलं शून्यं व्योम समं सदा । एवमेष चतुर्थोऽपि निश्चयो मोक्षसिद्धिदः
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ jagadvā sakalaṃ śūnyaṃ vyoma samaṃ sadā | evameṣa caturtho'pi niścayo mokṣasiddhidaḥ
verses.translation: "I, or the whole world, is void, always like space" — this fourth conviction too gives the accomplishment of liberation.

verses.sanskrit: एतेषां प्रथमः प्रोक्तस्तृष्णया बन्धयोग्यया । शुद्धतृष्णास्त्रयः स्वच्छा जीवन्मुक्ता विलासिनः
verses.transliteration: eteṣāṃ prathamaḥ proktastṛṣṇayā bandhayogyayā | śuddhatṛṣṇāstrayaḥ svacchā jīvanmuktā vilāsinaḥ
verses.translation: Of these, the first is said to be by craving fit for bondage; the three of pure craving are clear: the liberated-while-living, the sporting ones.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं चाप्यहमेवेति निश्चयो यो महामते । तमादाय विषादाय न भूयो जायते मतिः
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ cāpyahameveti niścayo yo mahāmate | tamādāya viṣādāya na bhūyo jāyate matiḥ
verses.translation: The conviction "all indeed is I alone," O great-minded — taking it, the mind no more arises toward despair.

verses.sanskrit: शून्यं तत्प्रकृतिर्माया ब्रह्मविज्ञानमित्यपि । शिवः पुरुष ईशानो नित्यमात्मेति कथ्यते
verses.transliteration: śūnyaṃ tatprakṛtirmāyā brahmavijñānamityapi | śivaḥ puruṣa īśāno nityamātmeti kathyate
verses.translation: It is called the void, nature, illusion, knowledge of Brahman; Shiva, Person, Lord, and the eternal Self.

verses.sanskrit: द्वैताद्वैतसमुद्भूतैर्जगन्निर्माणलीलया । परमात्ममयीशक्तिरद्वैतैव विजृम्भते
verses.transliteration: dvaitādvaitasamudbhūtairjagannirmāṇalīlayā | paramātmamayīśaktiradvaitaiva vijṛmbhate
verses.translation: By the dual and non-dual, in the sport of making the world, the power made of the Supreme Self expands as non-dual alone.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वातीतपदालम्बी परिपूर्णैकचिन्मयः । नोद्वेगी न च तुष्टात्मा संसारे नावसीदति
verses.transliteration: sarvātītapadālambī paripūrṇaikacinmayaḥ | nodvegī na ca tuṣṭātmā saṃsāre nāvasīdati
verses.translation: Relying on the state beyond all, fully one, made of consciousness, neither agitated nor self-satisfied, he does not sink in the world.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्तकर्मकरो नित्यं शत्रुमित्रसमानदृक् । ईहितानीहितैर्मुक्तो न शोचति न काङ्क्षति
verses.transliteration: prāptakarmakaro nityaṃ śatrumitrasamānadṛk | īhitānīhitairmukto na śocati na kāṅkṣati
verses.translation: Always doing the work that comes, seeing foe and friend alike, free of wished and unwished, he neither grieves nor longs.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्याभिमतं वक्ता चोदितः पेशलोक्तिमान् । आशयज्ञश्च भूतानां संसारे नावसीदति
verses.transliteration: sarvasyābhimataṃ vaktā coditaḥ peśaloktimān | āśayajñaśca bhūtānāṃ saṃsāre nāvasīdati
verses.translation: Speaking what is pleasing to all, urged, of gentle speech, knowing the minds of beings, he does not sink in the world.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वां दृष्टिमवष्टभ्य ध्येयत्यागविलासिनीम् । जीवन्मुक्ततया स्वस्थो लोके विहर विज्वरः
verses.transliteration: pūrvāṃ dṛṣṭimavaṣṭabhya dhyeyatyāgavilāsinīm | jīvanmuktatayā svastho loke vihara vijvaraḥ
verses.translation: Relying on the earlier view, delighting in the abandonment of objects of meditation, be at ease in the state of liberated-while-living, move in the world free of fever.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तःसंत्यक्तसर्वाशो वीतरागो विवासनः । बहिःसर्वसमाचारो लोके विहर विज्वरः
verses.transliteration: antaḥsaṃtyaktasarvāśo vītarāgo vivāsanaḥ | bahiḥsarvasamācāro loke vihara vijvaraḥ
verses.translation: With all hope abandoned within, passionless, free of impressions, conforming to everything outwardly, move in the world free of fever.

verses.sanskrit: बहिःकृत्रिमसंरंभो हृदि संरम्भवर्जितः । कर्ता बहिरकर्तान्तर्लोके विहर शुद्धधीः
verses.transliteration: bahiḥkṛtrimasaṃraṃbho hṛdi saṃrambhavarjitaḥ | kartā bahirakartāntarloke vihara śuddhadhīḥ
verses.translation: Outwardly with feigned activity, in the heart free of agitation, a doer outside, a non-doer within, move in the world with pure mind.

verses.sanskrit: त्यक्ताहंकृतिराश्वस्तमतिराकाशशोभनः । अगृहीतकलङ्काङ्को लोके विहर शुद्धधीः
verses.transliteration: tyaktāhaṃkṛtirāśvastamatirākāśaśobhanaḥ | agṛhītakalaṅkāṅko loke vihara śuddhadhīḥ
verses.translation: With egoism abandoned, mind comforted, shining like the sky, taking no stain or mark, move in the world with pure mind.

verses.sanskrit: उदारः पेशलाचारः सर्वाचारानुवृत्तिमान् । अन्तःसङ्गपरित्यागी बहिःसंभारवानिव । अन्तर्वैराग्यमादाय बहिराशोन्मुखेहितः
verses.transliteration: udāraḥ peśalācāraḥ sarvācārānuvṛttimān | antaḥsaṅgaparityāgī bahiḥsaṃbhāravāniva | antarvairāgyamādāya bahirāśonmukhehitaḥ
verses.translation: Noble, of gracious conduct, following all customs, within a renouncer of attachment, outwardly as if with many possessions; taking inner dispassion, outwardly acting as if intent on hope.

verses.sanskrit: अयं बन्धुरयं नेति गणना लघुचेतसाम् । उदारचरितानां तु वसुधैव कुटुम्बकम्
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ bandhurayaṃ neti gaṇanā laghucetasām | udāracaritānāṃ tu vasudhaiva kuṭumbakam
verses.translation: "This is a kinsman, this is not" — such counting is for the small-minded; for those of noble conduct, the whole earth is a family.

verses.sanskrit: भावाभावविनिर्मुक्तं जरामरणवर्जितम् । प्रशान्तकलनारभ्यं नीरागं पदमाश्रय
verses.transliteration: bhāvābhāvavinirmuktaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam | praśāntakalanārabhyaṃ nīrāgaṃ padamāśraya
verses.translation: Take refuge in the state free of being and non-being, free of old age and death, free of the beginnings of quieted imagining, without passion.

verses.sanskrit: एषा ब्राह्मी स्थितिः स्वच्छा निष्कामा विगतामया । आदाय विहरन्नेवं संकटेषु न मुह्यति
verses.transliteration: eṣā brāhmī sthitiḥ svacchā niṣkāmā vigatāmayā | ādāya viharannevaṃ saṃkaṭeṣu na muhyati
verses.translation: This is the Brahmic state, clear, desireless, free of disease; moving about with it thus, one is not bewildered in difficulties.

verses.sanskrit: वैराग्येणाथ शास्त्रेण महत्त्वादिगुणैरपि । यत्संकल्पहरार्थं तत्स्वयमेवोन्नयेन्मनः
verses.transliteration: vairāgyeṇātha śāstreṇa mahattvādiguṇairapi | yatsaṃkalpaharārthaṃ tatsvayamevonnayenmanaḥ
verses.translation: By dispassion, by scripture, and by qualities such as greatness, whatever is for the removal of intention, the mind should itself raise up.

verses.sanskrit: वैराग्यात्पूर्णतामेति मनो नाशवशानुगम् । आशया रक्ततामेति शरदीव सरोऽमलम्
verses.transliteration: vairāgyātpūrṇatāmeti mano nāśavaśānugam | āśayā raktatāmeti śaradīva saro'malam
verses.translation: By dispassion the mind goes to fullness, subject to its destruction; by hope it becomes colored, like a clear lake in autumn.

verses.sanskrit: तमेव भुक्तिविरसं व्यापारौघं पुनः पुनः । दिवसेदिवसे कुर्वन्प्राज्ञ कस्मान्न लज्जते
verses.transliteration: tameva bhuktivirasaṃ vyāpāraughaṃ punaḥ punaḥ | divasedivase kurvanprājña kasmānna lajjate
verses.translation: Doing the same flavorless flood of activities again and again day after day, O wise one, why are you not ashamed?

verses.sanskrit: चिच्चैत्यकलितो बन्धस्तन्मुक्तौ मुक्तिरुच्यते । चिदचैत्या किलात्मेति सर्वसिद्धान्तसंग्रहः
verses.transliteration: ciccaityakalito bandhastanmuktau muktirucyate | cidacaityā kilātmeti sarvasiddhāntasaṃgrahaḥ
verses.translation: Bondage is held by consciousness and the perceived; in its release, liberation is declared. Consciousness is not perceived — such is the Self: the summary of all doctrines.

verses.sanskrit: एतन्निश्चयमादाय विलोकय धियेद्धया । स्वयमेवात्मनात्मानमानन्दं पदमाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: etanniścayamādāya vilokaya dhiyeddhayā | svayamevātmanātmānamānandaṃ padamāpsyasi
verses.translation: Taking this conviction, behold with kindled intellect; you yourself, by yourself, will reach the state of bliss.

verses.sanskrit: चिदहं चिदिमे लोकाश्चिदाशाश्चिदिमाः प्रजाः । दृश्यदर्शननिर्मुक्तः केवलामलरूपवान्
verses.transliteration: cidahaṃ cidime lokāścidāśāścidimāḥ prajāḥ | dṛśyadarśananirmuktaḥ kevalāmalarūpavān
verses.translation: I am consciousness; these worlds are consciousness; the directions are consciousness; these creatures are consciousness. Freed from seen and seeing, of the form of the alone and spotless,

verses.sanskrit: नित्योदितो निराभासो द्रष्टा साक्षी चिदात्मकः
verses.transliteration: nityodito nirābhāso draṣṭā sākṣī cidātmakaḥ
verses.translation: ever risen, without appearance, the seer, the witness, of the nature of consciousness.

verses.sanskrit: चैत्यनिर्मुक्तचिद्रूपं पूर्णज्योतिःस्वरूपकम् । संशान्तसर्वसंवेद्यं संविन्मात्रमहं महत्
verses.transliteration: caityanirmuktacidrūpaṃ pūrṇajyotiḥsvarūpakam | saṃśāntasarvasaṃvedyaṃ saṃvinmātramahaṃ mahat
verses.translation: The form of consciousness freed from the perceived, of the nature of full light, with all knowables quieted — I am the great mere awareness.

verses.sanskrit: संशान्तसर्वसंकल्पः प्रशान्तसकलेषणः । निर्विकल्पपदं गत्वा स्वस्थो भव मुनीश्वर
verses.transliteration: saṃśāntasarvasaṃkalpaḥ praśāntasakaleṣaṇaḥ | nirvikalpapadaṃ gatvā svastho bhava munīśvara
verses.translation: With all intentions quieted, all desires stilled, having reached the state free of conceptions, be at ease in yourself, O lord of sages.

verses.sanskrit: इति । य इमां महोपनिषदं ब्राह्मणो नित्यमधीते । अश्रोत्रियः श्रोत्रियो भवति । अनुपनीत उपनीतो भवति । सोऽग्निपूतो भवति । स वायुपूतो भवति । स सोमपूतो भवति । स सत्यपूतो भवति । स सर्वपूतो भवति
verses.transliteration: iti | ya imāṃ mahopaniṣadaṃ brāhmaṇo nityamadhīte | aśrotriyaḥ śrotriyo bhavati | anupanīta upanīto bhavati | so'gnipūto bhavati | sa vāyupūto bhavati | sa somapūto bhavati | sa satyapūto bhavati | sa sarvapūto bhavati
verses.translation: Thus. The Brahmin who daily studies this Mahopanishad, though not a scholar becomes a scholar; though uninitiated becomes initiated; he becomes purified by fire; purified by wind; purified by soma; purified by truth; purified by all.

verses.sanskrit: स सर्वर्देवैर्ज्ञातो भवति । स सर्वेषु तीर्थेषु स्नातो भवति । स सर्वैर्देवैरनुध्यातो भवति । स सर्वक्रतुभिरिष्टवान्भवति । गायत्र्याः षष्टिसहस्राणि जप्तानि फलानि भवन्ति । इतिहासपुराणानां शतसहस्राणि जप्तानि फलानि भवन्ति
verses.transliteration: sa sarvardevairjñāto bhavati | sa sarveṣu tīrtheṣu snāto bhavati | sa sarvairdevairanudhyāto bhavati | sa sarvakratubhiriṣṭavānbhavati | gāyatryāḥ ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi japtāni phalāni bhavanti | itihāsapurāṇānāṃ śatasahasrāṇi japtāni phalāni bhavanti
verses.translation: He becomes known to all gods; he becomes bathed in all holy places; he becomes contemplated by all gods; he becomes one who has performed all sacrifices. The fruits of sixty thousand recitations of the Gayatri are obtained; the fruits of a hundred thousand recitations of histories and Puranas are obtained.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवानामयुतं जप्तं भवति । आचक्षुषः पङ्क्तिं पुनाति । आसप्तमान्पुरुषयुगान्पुनाति । इत्याह भगवान् हिरण्यगर्भः । जप्येनामृतत्त्वं च गच्छतीत्युपनिषत् ।
verses.transliteration: praṇavānāmayutaṃ japtaṃ bhavati | ācakṣuṣaḥ paṅktiṃ punāti | āsaptamānpuruṣayugānpunāti | ityāha bhagavān hiraṇyagarbhaḥ | japyenāmṛtattvaṃ ca gacchatītyupaniṣat |
verses.translation: Ten thousand recitations of Om are obtained. He purifies a row of the unseeing; he purifies seven generations of men. So said the revered Hiranyagarbha. By recitation he attains immortality — thus the Upanishad.
